digest.component_or_area: plan-review clarity measures and deterministic floor
propositions: Current clarity measure rewards volume and legacy shape (any H2, >=200/500 chars, any dash bullet) rather than enforcing required sections (Context/Problem, Approach, Scope, AC) keyed to graph altitude (leaf vs. container).
Clarity score logic is duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py without unified parsing, inviting drift and inconsistency when extended.

Author guide documents Success Criteria for containers but active tests ignore it; guide requires rejected-alternative wording but authoritative G6 forbids requiring it (conflict ticket 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 created).
Deterministic per-AC verification coverage (proved_items/total_items) and placeholder-free executable scope (TBD, figure out, verify whether, etc.) are detectable signals absent from current checks.

Testing section shape (happy-path + failure/edge/boundary markers, optional live/end-to-end for migrations) and grounded edit-set (nonempty Scope plus structured file_impact) can be mechanically tested without semantic judgment.
LLM-reviewed criteria (persona/problem quality, mechanism correctness, alternatives, coherence, test exercise coverage) must remain separate from deterministic checks to avoid filler compensation.
